lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: It's me.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I've set up a dummy ID and created a chat room for security reasons.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: We're using Elysion's top-secret channel.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: It should be safe to talk here.
Isn't your screen name a bit obvious?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Not at all.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: No one will know it's me.
If you say so.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Anyway, you said you encountered Red Hood?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I saw that she went into overdrive, so I assumed this might happen.
Can you explain this?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: It's confidential,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: but since you've met Red Hood face-to-face, I'll give you full disclosure. It will make things easier going forward.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Rapi and Red Hood share the same body.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: To be more precise, it's like two bodies compressed into one.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Her body weight is therefore twice the normal size,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: and she possesses two cores.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Command authority of the body belongs entirely to Rapi.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: When needed, Red Hood's body can be activated.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: During that time, each body will contest with the other to gain control.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: The two cores repel each other.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: The amount of energy released during this reaction eclipses even that of a Heretic.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: This allows her to exert a power

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: beyond any of our comprehension.
It's all starting to make sense now.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: However, the longer her body exists in this state of immense output,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: the more control will shift over to Red Hood.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: As long as it is stopped before control is completely transferred,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: a toxin within Rapi's body

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: disintegrates Red Hood's presence within her own.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: This process generates extremely high temperatures,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: to the point that unless you expose her to large amounts of coolant, it will reach her brain.
What then? Would she disintegrate? Is it fatal?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: More or less.
And Red Hood is the only casualty of this process?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: To be precise, although the parasitic entity that leeches off Rapi's body is dissolved,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Red Hood's core itself remains unaltered.
If what you're saying is true, how do you explain the fact that Red Hood is still alive and well?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: If Rapi's body is reassembled, Red Hood will reappear along with it.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: We've tried every method under the sun, but Red Hood consistently resurrects during the reconstruction process.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: However, any brain waves detected belong solely to Rapi.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Although it's embarrassing to admit,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: we haven't a clue as to why this is happening.
Has Red Hood ever completely taken over?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Yes,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: but only once.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Fortunately for us,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: we were able to introduce the toxin into the body externally,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: which caused her to revert back to Rapi.
So that's what you gave me.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Precisely.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Stick Red Hood with that,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: and her body will disintegrate,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: allowing Rapi to return.
Understood.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: But a word of warning:

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: It won't be easy.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: She'll put up a fight.
Only natural, considering it'll end her life.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: No,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Rapi will be the one who resists.
What?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: When Rapi turned into Red Hood,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Red Hood remained unconscious.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Nevertheless, when we attempted to administer the toxin,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: she put up some fierce resistance.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: It's a miracle that no one lost their life.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I thought she was operating on instinct alone,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: but we noticed Red Hood's brainwaves were in lockstep with Rapi's.
What could that possibly mean?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: As time passed, Rapi's brainwaves gradually weakened.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: At the same time, her resistance decreased, which afforded us an opportunity to introduce the toxin.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: When Rapi was brought back,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: she had lost several months' worth of memories.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Our hypothesis is that

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: the longer Red Hood remains in control,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: the greater the memory loss Rapi suffers.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: So hurry.
Red Hood said that she could hear Rapi's voice.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Well.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Could she make out what she was saying?
"Head home"

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: When Rapi last activated Red Hood,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: she mentioned she was able to hear Red Hood's voice.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: We might be dealing with something similar to that.
What did Red Hood say to Rapi?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Destroy

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: the Ark.
What?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Have you seen any signs of such behavior?
I don't think so.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: So long as she's not displaying any obvious signs of malice, you don't have to fixate on that.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Nevertheless, it would be best to keep it in mind moving forward.
Noted.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: If the situation changes, report back.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I'll be waiting.
Wait.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: What is it?
Am I to keep this conversation between us?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: If this information were to get out, it could turn the Ark upside down.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: However.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: If you feel it will help bring Rapi back,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: you may share it with your colleagues if you feel it is necessary.
Even though it's highly confidential intelligence?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Only a few parties are involved in this situation.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: It'll come off as a fantastical story cooked up by conspiratorial crackpots.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Burying with more easily digestible information will be easy enough.
That's actually fairly terrifying.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Fortunately, there are no concerns about the Counters having their brains scanned.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Have you encountered any other individuals?
We met with Dorothy.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Anyone else?
We also ran into some unidentified Nikkes.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Are they Pilgrims?
We believe so.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: it doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: We can be glad that they're at least Pilgrims.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: If you feel it will help,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: share the information.
Thank you.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Good luck.
